description: This Java class defines a UI component for live 3D data visualization, specifically plotting points in a 3D space based on incoming messages. It utilizes external libraries for plotting and UI components and manages real-time data points addition.

classes.name: Live3DReport
classes.description: A UI component that visualizes real-time 3D data points, integrates message listening and plotting functionalities.

methods.name: Live3DReport
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the 3D plot and message listener for real-time data updates.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Parses a message string, extracts data points, and adds them to the 3D plot.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Returns the Swing component control for embedding in UI.
